_about: Allowed values for the notebook header fields used by the notebook search and filters on colab.ampl.com. Checked by scripts/check_headers.py. Add a value here only when no existing one fits.

model_type.LP: Linear program: continuous variables, linear objective and constraints
model_type.MILP: Mixed-integer linear program: linear, with binary or integer variables (including logical constraints reformulated by MP)
model_type.Stochastic MILP: MILP with scenarios or uncertainty (two-stage, Benders, etc.)
model_type.QP: Quadratic objective, continuous variables, linear constraints
model_type.MIQP: QP with binary or integer variables
model_type.Conic: Second-order, exponential or other cone constraints
model_type.NLP: Nonlinear objective or constraints, continuous variables
model_type.MINLP: Nonlinear, with binary or integer variables
model_type.CP: Constraint programming: alldiff, counting and similar combinatorial constraints solved with a CP solver
model_type.Complementarity: Complementarity conditions (complements), e.g. economic equilibrium solved with PATH
model_type.MPEC: Mathematical program with equilibrium constraints, e.g. bilevel models reformulated with KKT conditions

level.Quick Start: Setup and first steps: installing amplpy, loading data
level.Lecture: Teaching material, introductions and API or feature tutorials
level.Case Study: A worked optimization problem from start to finish
level.Industry Prototype: A realistic business model close to industrial use
